items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Joe Schultz; the name is introduced solely by the interviewer.

ctx.x: Johnny Peretti. Yeah, he worked in there during the carnival season. It wasn't a steady job through that. I mean I don't... Now Cobbs, when they started... Fulco played in Cobbs straight on for...
Well he was in Cobbs with Sandy and... Yeah, with Sandy and Joe Schultz and...
And playing string music. Yeah, playing string music in Cobbs. Who is Sandy?
